description: This file defines the class EndOfDayBalance, which models the end-of-day account balances and contains methods to compute interest, aggregate balances over periods, and handle interest calculations related to savings accounts.

classes.name: EndOfDayBalance
classes.description: Represents the end-of-day balance for a savings account, including methods to calculate accrued interest, aggregate balances, and manage date intervals for interest calculations.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of EndOfDayBalance with given date, opening balance, end-of-day balance, and number of days.

methods.name: date
methods.description: Returns the date associated with this balance.

methods.name: cumulativeBalance
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative balance over a number of days, considering interest to compound.

methods.name: calculateInterestOnBalance
methods.description: Calculates interest on the balance based on various parameters such as interest rate, overdraft rate, and minimum balances.

methods.name: calculateInterestOnBalanceAndInterest
methods.description: Calculates the future value of the balance considering compounded interest over the period.

methods.name: upTo
methods.description: Returns a new EndOfDayBalance representing the balance period up to a specified date, adjusted for date intervals.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if this balance interval contains a portion of the specified date interval.

methods.name: getNumberOfDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the balance period.
